title: Personal Checking: monthly maintenance fee and balance-based waiver levels by tier
content:
## Scope

This reference sets out, for every Personal Checking tier, the monthly maintenance fee and the four waiver levels that depend on balances or account activity, together with whether outstanding PCB mortgage principal counts toward the tier's Relationship Balance.

## Parameter table

| Tier | Monthly maintenance fee (USD) | Lowest daily balance waiver (USD) | Direct deposit total waiver (USD) | Relationship Balance waiver (USD) | Debit card purchase count waiver | Mortgage principal counts toward the Relationship Balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 5.00 | Not offered | Not offered | Not offered | Not offered | No |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | Not offered | Not offered | Not offered | Not offered | No |
| Everyday Checking | 12.00 | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 5000.00 | 10 purchases | No |
| Interest Checking | 15.00 | 5000.00 | Not offered | 15000.00 | Not offered | No |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 | 10000.00 | Not offered | 25000.00 | Not offered | Yes |
| Private Client Checking | 35.00 | Not offered | Not offered | 250000.00 | Not offered | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Monthly maintenance fee**: the fee assessed once per statement cycle at cycle close unless a waiver is met.
- **Lowest daily balance waiver**: the fee is waived when the lowest end-of-day ledger balance during the cycle is at or above this figure.
- **Direct deposit total waiver**: the fee is waived when the total of ACH direct deposits posted in the cycle is at or above this figure.
- **Relationship Balance waiver**: the fee is waived when the Relationship Balance at cycle close is at or above this figure.
- **Debit card purchase count waiver**: the fee is waived when the number of posted debit card purchases in the cycle is at or above this count.
- **Mortgage principal counts**: whether outstanding PCB mortgage principal is counted toward this tier's Relationship Balance.
- **Not offered**: the tier does not offer that waiver at all.

## Points of judgement (derived from the table)

- **Every waiver level is an "at or above" test.** A hypothetical Everyday Checking account whose lowest end-of-day balance in the cycle is exactly 1500.00 USD reaches the lowest daily balance waiver level; at 1499.99 USD it does not.
- **Only Everyday Checking offers the direct deposit and purchase-count levels.** A hypothetical Premier Checking owner with 20 debit card purchases in a cycle gains nothing from that count, because Premier Checking does not offer the purchase-count waiver.
- **Mortgage principal is counted only for Premier Checking and Private Client Checking.** For the other four tiers the Relationship Balance is formed without any mortgage principal.
- **Student Checking** carries a monthly maintenance fee of 0.00 USD, so no waiver level is needed for that tier.
